# Massage 4 Beauty

> Facial and body massage studio in Prague run by Liudmyla Yemelianova, a certified massage therapist with over ten years of experience. Treatments include lifting, myofascial, lymphatic drainage and relaxation massage for both face and body.

Massage 4 Beauty (Beauty Massage) is a home-based massage studio located in Praha 4 – Nusle. Treatment pages are published in Czech, English and Russian, each language on its own URL and linked by hreflang. Czech is canonical.

## Business info

- Address: Děkanská vinice I 819/16, Praha 4 – Nusle, Czech Republic
- Phone: +420 721 761 411
- Email: beautymassage.prague@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://beautymassage.cz/): Services overview, about the therapist, full price list and booking form. Available in all three languages via an on-page switch.
- [All massages](https://beautymassage.cz/sluzby/): Index of every treatment, grouped into facial massage, body massage and gift vouchers. English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/sluzby/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/sluzby/
- [Privacy Policy](https://beautymassage.cz/privacy): Data processing, analytics and cookie policy.

## Treatment pages

Each page covers one treatment in depth - what it is, how the session runs, its effects, who it suits, contraindications, price and FAQs.

- [Signature massage by Liudmyla](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/autorska-masaz-obliceje/): Based on my own signature technique, combining specialised massage methods to improve skin tone, relieve facial tension, reduce puffiness and restore a fresh, relaxed and radiant appearance.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/autorska-masaz-obliceje/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/autorska-masaz-obliceje/
- [Facial massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/masaz-obliceje/): Deep, multi-layered care for the face, neck, décolleté and head. It releases the tension held in your expression, softens lines and brings tone back to the skin - no needles, no downtime.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/masaz-obliceje/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/masaz-obliceje/
- [Myofascial facial massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/myofascialni-masaz-obliceje/): Deep work with the fascia - the connective tissue wrapping every muscle and holding the face in contraction. The most effective technique if you want to firm the jawline and dissolve years of held tension.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/myofascialni-masaz-obliceje/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/myofascialni-masaz-obliceje/
- [Lifting facial massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/liftingova-masaz-obliceje/): An intensive lifting technique that works against gravity. It firms the contour, lifts the corners of the mouth and brings a fresh look back to the face - no needles, no downtime at all.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/liftingova-masaz-obliceje/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/liftingova-masaz-obliceje/
- [Buccal massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/bukalni-masaz/): A massage worked from inside the mouth - the only technique that reaches the chewing muscles directly. The most effective way to firm the contour and release a jaw clenched for years.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/bukalni-masaz/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/bukalni-masaz/
- [Facial lymphatic massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/lymfaticka-masaz-obliceje/): The gentlest of all facial massages. It carries away retained water, reduces under-eye bags and gives the face its sharp contours back - often within a single treatment.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/lymfaticka-masaz-obliceje/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/lymfaticka-masaz-obliceje/
- [Vacuum facial massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/vakuova-masaz-obliceje/): Gentle suction cups that lift the skin instead of pressing on it. They tone the muscles, improve skin elasticity and bring out the contours of the face.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/vakuova-masaz-obliceje/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/vakuova-masaz-obliceje/
- [Gua Sha facial massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/gua-sha-masaz-obliceje/): A draining, contouring ritual with a smooth stone. It releases tension in the face, helps clear puffiness and improves skin tone using traditional Gua Sha techniques.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/gua-sha-masaz-obliceje/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/gua-sha-masaz-obliceje/
- [Neck, décolleté and hands massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/masaz-krku-dekoltu-a-rukou/): An hour of care for the areas skin care often forgets. The massage improves circulation and lymph flow, relaxes the muscles of the neck and chest, and leaves the skin of the neck and décolleté fresh and more elastic.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/masaz-krku-dekoltu-a-rukou/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/masaz-krku-dekoltu-a-rukou/
- [Head massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/masaz-hlavy/): Thirty minutes in which your head finally switches off. Massage of the scalp, temples and neck releases tension, calms the nervous system and helps you let go of stress.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/masaz-hlavy/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/masaz-hlavy/
- [Alginate mask](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/alginatova-maska/): Fifteen extra minutes that round off a facial massage beautifully. The alginate mask reduces puffiness and redness, evens out skin tone, deeply hydrates and soothes the skin.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/alginatova-maska/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/alginatova-maska/
- [Sports Massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/sportovni-masaz/): Muscle recovery after physical exertion and intense training. The massage releases tension, eases soreness and helps the body recover faster.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/sportovni-masaz/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/sportovni-masaz/
- [Massage with Bamboo Whisks](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/masaz-bambusovymi-metlickami/): The body is gently warmed and massaged with bundles of thin bamboo sticks. The rhythmic tapping improves circulation, lymph flow and skin tone.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/masaz-bambusovymi-metlickami/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/masaz-bambusovymi-metlickami/
- [Lymphatic drainage massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/lymfaticka-masaz/): Manual lymphatic drainage that gets the lymph moving, eases swelling and gives your legs their lightness back. Gentle, slow and deeply calming - no pain, no machines.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/lymfaticka-masaz/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/lymfaticka-masaz/
- [Anti-Cellulite Massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/anticelulitidova-masaz/): Intensive work on problem areas. The massage improves circulation, stimulates fat breakdown and firms the skin.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/anticelulitidova-masaz/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/anticelulitidova-masaz/
- [Honey Massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/medova-masaz/): A massage with natural honey that cleanses the skin and activates metabolism. Afterwards the skin is smoother, softer and refreshed.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/medova-masaz/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/medova-masaz/
- [Classic massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/klasicka-masaz/): The classic you cannot go wrong with. An hour in which I work through the back, legs, arms and neck, and not one spot is forgotten.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/klasicka-masaz/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/klasicka-masaz/
- [Aroma massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/aroma-masaz/): An hour in which nothing needs solving. Slow flowing strokes, warm aromatic oil and a closing head massage that sends most clients to sleep.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/aroma-masaz/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/aroma-masaz/
- [Vacuum (Cupping) Body Massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/vakuova-masaz-tela/): Cups that draw the tissue up instead of pressing it down. They actively stimulate blood and lymph circulation, reduce swelling and help fight cellulite.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/vakuova-masaz-tela/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/vakuova-masaz-tela/
- [Back massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/masaz-zad/): Targeted deep massage exactly where it hurts most - between the shoulder blades, in the shoulders and along the cervical spine. The fastest relief from a day spent at a computer.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/masaz-zad/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/masaz-zad/
- [Reflexology Foot Massage](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/reflexni-masaz-chodidel/): A technique working on biologically active points and zones of the feet linked to the internal organs and body systems. Stimulating them supports natural regeneration and overall relaxation.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/reflexni-masaz-chodidel/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/reflexni-masaz-chodidel/
- [Gift voucher](https://beautymassage.cz/masaze/darkovy-poukaz/): A gift that never misses. Choose a massage or an amount and leave the rest to me - the voucher arrives by e-mail within 24 hours, ready to print or forward.
  English: https://beautymassage.cz/en/masaze/darkovy-poukaz/ - Russian: https://beautymassage.cz/ru/masaze/darkovy-poukaz/
